expired.title: Your session has expired
expired.detail: Sign in again to see the schedule.

forbidden.title: You cannot see this schedule
forbidden.detail: One of the reference endpoints this page reads refused. The permissions it needs are named by the schedule middleware.

missing.title: This schedule is not there
missing.detail: The term or grid this view asked for no longer exists.

unknown.title: Could not load the schedule
unknown.detail: The request did not come back. Nothing has been changed, and your timetable is intact.

my.denied: You do not have permission to use this page. It needs {missing}. Ask an administrator to grant it.

review.denied: You do not have permission to review schedule proposals. It needs: generation.read.

schedule.denied: You do not have permission to view the schedule. It needs session.read (everyone’s) or session.read_own (your own).
